name: AI assistant
description: Puts a chat assistant inside the app: it understands this app, answers land in the conversation, and it never touches code

zh.name: AI 小助手
zh.description: 在应用里放一个会聊天的助手：它读得懂这个应用，回答写在对话里，不碰代码

agentHints: This app already has the "AI assistant" component installed (component id: tenon.official.ai-assistant). It is for the end user, not a tool for you to edit the page with: do not write your own chat box, and do not edit its facet files. To change where it sits or turn it off, edit its mount in app.components.json; to remove it, delete this entry from the assembly declaration. It has no tools, cannot change code and cannot commit.
